item.title: Qualis: An open-source platform for Q-methodology research
item.description:
Julien Vastenaekels, Clémence Dedinger
Qualis is a self-hosted, open-source web application that integrates the complete Q-methodology workflow — study design, recruitment, online data collection, factor analysis, and export — into a single platform. It supports any device, multilingual studies, and exports to PQMethod, Ken-Q Analysis, and the R qmethod package.

item.title: CRediT Matrix
item.description:
Simon van Lierde
A client-side web app and TypeScript library for drafting CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) contribution statements for scholarly publications, with a contribution heatmap and JATS4R XML, CSV, JSON, and Markdown exports for journal submission systems. Contributors can be filled in from an ORCID iD or a DOI, and the interface and the generated statement are localized independently across nine languages.
